preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some JizzJet tokens to trigger the swapAndLiquify function
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens from fees to reach numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity threshold

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the sendBNBToAdmin function which uses transfer() without checking the return value. If the admin wallet is a contract that reverts or runs out of gas, the entire swapAndLiquify transaction will fail, locking funds in the contract. To exploit: 1) Ensure contract has accumulated fee tokens, 2) Trigger swapAndLiquify by transferring tokens (not from uniswapV2Pair) when contract balance >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity, 3) If admin wallet is problematic, the transaction may fail but tokens could still be swapped to ETH, potentially leaving ETH stuck or creating MEV opportunities. The economic gain comes from manipulating the failed transaction state to extract value through sandwich attacks or gas griefing.
